Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The city conducts cultural heritage fire drills every year with the help of local residents to protect historic buildings and structures from fire and other disasters. This year's drill will be held at Jōrakuin Temple (Takayama Fudō).

【Date and Time】
Sunday, October 25, 2026 (Reiwa 8), starting at 2:00 PM for approximately 1 hour

【Location】
Jōrakuin Temple (Takayama 346)

【Other Information】
On the day of the drill, surrounding roads will be temporarily closed from 1:50 PM until the end of the drill. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kyoikubu/hakubutsukan/bunkazaitanto/bunkazai/14146.html
